eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Georgia; at 2:59 AM on AUG 17, 2026 Effective until 8:59 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
We interrupt this program to bring you this important announcement. This is an emergency missing child alert, or Levis Call, the Georgia version of an Amber Alert. The ATLANATA POLICE DEPARTMENT and the GEORGIA 
BUREAU OF INVESTIGATION are looking for a WHITE FORD F350 with Alabama License tag 1C087Y4. On 
August 17, 2026, Norah  Copper , a 11 month old, Black, Female with Black Hair and Brown Eyes and was last seen wearing a Pink Onesie.  And Zola Cooper, a 4 Yr old, Female with Black Hair and Brown Eyes  and was last seen wearing a multcolored Dress,  was abducted by Lakesha Brown. They were last seen at 356 James P. Brawley Drive NW.  Zola and Norah Cooper is believed to be in extreme danger. If you have any information on the whereabouts of Zola and Norah Cooper or the WHITE FORD F350 with Alabama License tag 1C087Y4. please dial 911. The public can also provide information to the GBI tip line at 1-800-597-TIPS or the See Send app for smartphone users.
